templates.title: Victor mural at Capen
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody sprayed over the Victor the Bull mural in rival blue.
WHERE: The outside wall of Capen Hall, facing the Union.
WHEN: 4:40 PM to 5:10 PM.
MOTIVE: Rival week. Somebody wanted Victor humiliated before Saturday's game.
templates.scene: The Capen Hall wall, facing the Student Union
templates.act: went out the dock door and sprayed over Victor
templates.alibiPlace: at my club table in the Union
templates.motive: A transfer from the rival school, or someone who lost a bet on the rivalry, wanted the mural ruined before the game.
templates.solvePath: The alibi photo is from 4:25 PM, before the window. The culprit's Union dock door swipes bracket the window exactly. The innocent red herring is primer, not spray paint, and the cans are sealed in club storage.
templates.accessDescription: Student Union loading dock door. {name}'s card swiped OUT at 4:38 PM and back IN at 5:09 PM. The dock door opens onto the path to the Capen wall. It is sixty feet from the mural.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} slipped out of the club fair through the dock door, sprayed the mural, and came back in before teardown.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the club fair vendor sheet at 3:05 PM. The time-out column is blank.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is cc'd on the 'rival week ideas' email thread. Somebody in the thread wrote 'Victor needs a makeover' on Tuesday.
templates.alibiDescription: A photo from the club fair, 4:25 PM. {name} is at a table in the Union atrium, handing out flyers. The photo is from before the mural was hit.
templates.redHerringDescription: A receipt on {name}'s card, 3:40 PM. Two cans of exterior primer and a roll of painter's tape.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} bought the primer for a club parade float. Both cans are still sealed in the club storage cage. The mural was done in blue spray paint, not primer.
templates.statementTemplate: I was at my club table in the Union the whole time. I didn't step outside until teardown.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Student Union front doors. {name}'s card swiped IN at 2:55 PM. That door is the public entrance for the club fair. There is no swipe for {name} on the loading dock.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} came in the front door for the club fair at 2:55 PM. That swipe is not the dock door by the mural.

templates.title: Copied badge at Norton
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody opened a locked faculty office with a cloned card and read a sealed recommendation letter.
WHERE: The faculty hallway on the third floor of Norton Hall.
WHEN: 9:05 PM to 9:40 PM.
MOTIVE: A recommendation letter was sitting in that office, and somebody needed to know what it said.
templates.scene: The third-floor faculty hallway in Norton Hall
templates.act: wrote the SE-B card on my login and used it on the Norton office door
templates.alibiPlace: at the gym at Alumni Arena
templates.motive: Grad school applications are due Friday. The letter decided whether the applicant had a shot.
templates.solvePath: The door was opened by card SE-B, which has no name. The card writer log shows SE-B was written under the culprit's operator login. The gym turnstile only logs entry, so it proves nothing about 9:22 PM. The red herring key doesn't fit a card door.
templates.accessDescription: ID Office card writer. At 4:16 PM a blank card was written as number SE-B. The writer requires an operator login. The operator logged in from 4:00 PM to 4:30 PM was {name}. Card SE-B opened the Norton faculty office at 9:22 PM.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} wrote card SE-B during their ID desk shift, kept it, and used it to open the Norton office at 9:22 PM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed in at the ID office at 4:00 PM and out at 4:30 PM. They were the only worker on the card writer during that half hour.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} has a pending recommendation request with the professor whose office was opened. The letter was due to be sealed Friday.
templates.alibiDescription: Alumni Arena gym turnstile. {name}'s card tapped IN at 8:41 PM. The turnstile only logs entries. There is no record of when anyone left.
templates.redHerringDescription: {name} signed out Norton hallway key K-3 at 8:40 PM and returned it at 9:50 PM. Key K-3 opens the classroom wing on the same floor as the faculty offices.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} was locking up Norton classrooms after a review session in the other wing. Key K-3 is a classroom key. The faculty office is a card reader door, and no key fits it.
templates.statementTemplate: I was at the gym at Alumni. My own card was in my pocket the whole night, and I never touched that office.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: ID Office card writer. At 2:10 PM a replacement student ID was written while {name} was logged in as the operator. The card number is the student's own ID. The student signed for it at the window. The card is not SE-B.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} wrote a named replacement ID at 2:10 PM. That card is not SE-B, and the student signed for it.

templates.title: Party at Hadley 4B
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody hosted a party in a dry building and an underage recruit ended up at the health center.
WHERE: Unit 4B in Hadley Village.
WHEN: 10:40 PM to 12:10 AM.
MOTIVE: A recruit visit turned into a party, and the host needs the blame on somebody else before the coach hears.
templates.act: was the one hosting in 4B that night
templates.motive: The host's scholarship is conditional on conduct. If the party is theirs, the scholarship is gone.
templates.solvePath: The laundry sign-in is 11:20 PM, but the machine log shows no cycle under that name. The culprit's delivery order to 4B at 11:31 PM, with knock instructions, puts them inside. The innocent's guest sign-in has a signed guest sign-out.
templates.accessDescription: A food delivery to Hadley unit 4B at 11:31 PM, ordered from {name}'s account. Four pizzas. Delivery note: 'knock twice, don't ring, people sleeping.' Delivered and confirmed.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} was inside 4B at 11:31 PM, feeding the party and telling the driver not to ring the bell.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Hadley laundry room sheet at 11:20 PM. No sign-out time.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the approved guest list for unit 4B this semester.
templates.alibiDescription: Hadley laundry machine log for the night. No washer or dryer cycle was started under {name}'s account between 10:00 PM and 1:00 AM.
templates.redHerringDescription: {name} signed a non-resident guest into Hadley at 10:15 PM. The guest's name is not on the 4B list.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name}'s guest was a cousin dropping off a textbook. The guest signed out at 10:50 PM, and the desk worker initialed it.
templates.statementTemplate: I was in the laundry room. I heard the music like everybody else. I wasn't in 4B.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: A food delivery to the Hadley third-floor lounge at 8:05 PM, ordered from {name}'s account. Two pizzas for a floor meeting. The delivery note says 'leave at the RA desk.' It was not addressed to unit 4B.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} ordered pizza for a floor meeting at 8:05 PM. The order went to the RA desk, not unit 4B.

templates.title: Chem 201 answer key
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody printed the Chem 201 midterm answer key from the TA's folder.
WHERE: Room 214 in Furnas Hall.
WHEN: 1:04 AM to 1:28 AM.
MOTIVE: The midterm is at 8 AM and it's worth forty percent of the grade.
templates.motive: One more failed exam and the student loses their major.
templates.solvePath: The print job came from a shared login, but the printer requires an ID tap to release the job. The tap names the culprit. The Capen card entry at 1:31 PM is after the window. The innocent's USB is a practice set turned in at 6 PM.
templates.accessDescription: Furnas 214 printer. A job named chem201_key_FINAL.pdf was sent at 1:17 AM from the shared night login. The printer holds jobs until someone taps a UB card to release them. Release tap: {name}, 1:17 AM.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} sent the key to the printer on the shared login and tapped their own card to release it at 1:17 AM.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed into Furnas 214 at 10:30 PM. The time-out line is blank.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is one of six students with the Furnas 214 shared night login. The login was active from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM.
templates.alibiDescription: Capen 24-hour study room. {name}'s card entered at 1:31 AM. There is no earlier entry that night.
templates.redHerringDescription: A USB drive turned in to lost-and-found under {name}'s student number. The sticker says 201-KEY. Return time on the slip: 6:00 PM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name}'s drive is a practice key from office hours. It was turned in at 6 PM, seven hours before the print job, and the files on it are practice problems.
templates.statementTemplate: I left 214 a little after one and walked straight to Capen. The printer wasn't running when I left.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Furnas 214 printer. A job named chem201_practice.pdf was released at 6:05 PM when {name} tapped their card. The file is the practice set from office hours. It is not chem201_key_FINAL, and 6:05 PM is hours before the print at 1:17 AM.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} released a practice set at 6:05 PM. That is not the answer-key file, and it is not 1:17 AM.

templates.title: Shove in the Ellicott tunnel
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody shoved a student into the tunnel wall hard enough to crack a tooth.
WHERE: The mid-section of the Ellicott tunnel.
WHEN: 11:12 PM to 11:28 PM.
MOTIVE: The victim deleted their group's project slides forty minutes earlier.
templates.act: followed them into the tunnel and shoved them
templates.motive: The deleted slides were due at midnight. Somebody lost their temper over a semester's work.
templates.solvePath: Everyone was in the project thread. The dorm Wi-Fi reaches the tunnel entrance, so that proves little. The tunnel mid-section access point only reaches the tunnel, and it logged the culprit's phone during the window. The innocent's bruise photo was taken at 5:12 PM.
templates.accessDescription: Ellicott tunnel mid-section Wi-Fi access point ELL-TUN-02. {name}'s phone connected at 11:15 PM and dropped at 11:26 PM. That access point is buried in the middle of the tunnel and does not reach any dorm.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} was standing in the middle of the Ellicott tunnel from 11:15 to 11:26 PM, when the shove happened.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed out of the Ellicott project review room at 11:05 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is in the project group chat. The slides were deleted at 10:40 PM. {name} reacted to the deletion message with an angry emoji.
templates.alibiDescription: Dorm Wi-Fi access point. {name}'s phone was connected at 11:08 PM. That access point also covers the tunnel entrance.
templates.redHerringDescription: A photo posted from {name}'s account at 11:40 PM. A fresh bruise on a forearm. Caption: 'tunnel night.'
templates.redHerringExplanation: The photo's file data says it was taken at 5:12 PM. 'Tunnel night' is what the rugby team calls their Thursday tackle drill. {name} got the bruise at practice.
templates.statementTemplate: I left the review and went back to my dorm. I never saw them after the meeting.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Ellicott tunnel entrance. {name}'s radio checked in at 10:50 PM at the mouth of the tunnel. That radio point does not reach the mid-section. The shove was logged on the mid-section access point at 11:15 PM.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} checked in at the tunnel mouth at 10:50 PM. The shove was on the mid-section point at 11:15 PM.

templates.title: Bike taken from Goodyear
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody cut the lock off a blue Trek and walked it out of the cage.
WHERE: The bike cage behind Goodyear Hall.
WHEN: 7:10 PM to 7:40 PM.
MOTIVE: Somebody needed cash tonight and the Trek was the nicest bike in the cage.
templates.scene: The bike cage behind Goodyear Hall
templates.act: cut the lock and walked the Trek out
templates.alibiPlace: at the intramural game at Goodyear
templates.motive: Rent, a fine, or a debt that couldn't wait until Friday.
templates.solvePath: The intramural game ended at 7:00 PM, before the window. The marketplace listing from the culprit's account at 7:58 PM is selling the exact bike. The innocent's bolt cutters were returned at 5:40 PM with the shop supervisor's signature.
templates.accessDescription: A listing posted to the campus marketplace at 7:58 PM from {name}'s account. 'Blue Trek, great condition, cash tonight only, meet near Goodyear.' The photo was taken in a stairwell. The listing was deleted at 9:10 PM.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} took the Trek out of the cage and listed it for sale eighteen minutes later.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Goodyear intramural sheet at 6:05 PM for the 6:15 PM game.
templates.rosterDescription: The bike cage key list. {name} is not on it. Nobody who used the cage tonight is on it. The cage was propped open with a brick.
templates.alibiDescription: Intramural box score for the 6:15 PM game. {name} played. The game ended at 7:00 PM.
templates.redHerringDescription: Theater scene shop checkout. {name} signed out a pair of bolt cutters at 4:50 PM.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} cut a rusted padlock off a set piece and returned the bolt cutters at 5:40 PM. The shop supervisor signed the return line.
templates.statementTemplate: I played in the intramural game and then I hung around the courts. I don't even know what a Trek looks like.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: A listing posted to the campus marketplace at 4:10 PM from {name}'s account. 'Bike helmet, size large, cash.' The photo is a black helmet. The listing is still up. It is not a blue Trek, and 4:10 PM is before the cage was hit.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} listed a helmet at 4:10 PM. The stolen bike was a blue Trek listed after 7:40 PM.

templates.title: Threat notes in Lockwood
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody left two printed threats in a lab partner's study room.
WHERE: Study room 212 in Lockwood Library.
WHEN: 6:50 PM to 8:20 PM.
MOTIVE: The partner just took sole credit for a group project. Somebody wanted them scared.
templates.act: booked that room and left the notes
templates.alibiPlace: out of Lockwood and back at my place
templates.motive: The credit on that project was the difference between a research spot and nothing.
templates.solvePath: Everyone badged out of Lockwood at 6:40 PM. Only the culprit booked room 212 from the lobby kiosk at 6:52 PM, which means they came back in without badging. The innocent's angry email is from a dorm IP, and the partner replied to it.
templates.accessDescription: Lockwood study room 212 was booked for 7:00 to 8:00 PM at 6:52 PM from the lobby kiosk. The booking is under {name}'s account. The notes were found taped inside room 212.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} came back into Lockwood after badging out, booked room 212 from the kiosk, and left the notes inside it.
templates.signInDescription: Lockwood door log. {name} badged OUT at 6:40 PM. There is no badge-in after that. The front door is held open by study groups most nights.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} was on the project that the lab partner took sole credit for. The credit change was posted at 5:30 PM.
templates.alibiDescription: Lockwood badge-out for {name} is 6:40 PM. That is ten minutes before the window opens. The log doesn't show who walked in behind someone else.
templates.redHerringDescription: An email from {name} to the lab partner at 7:20 PM. Subject: 'you know what you did.' The body calls them a thief and says they'll answer for it.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} sent the email from their dorm. The partner replied at 7:35 PM, and the two argued over email for an hour. Somebody writing emails from a dorm wasn't taping notes in Lockwood.
templates.statementTemplate: I badged out of Lockwood at 6:40 and I didn't go back in. Whatever I think of them, I don't leave notes.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Lockwood study room 104 was booked under {name} from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The booking was made on the website at 4:40 PM. Room 104 is on the first floor. The notes were found in room 212, which this booking does not open.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} booked room 104 before the window. The notes were in room 212.

templates.title: Telescope lens at Fronczak
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody unscrewed the main objective lens off the rooftop telescope the night before Observatory Night.
WHERE: The rooftop observatory on Fronczak Hall.
WHEN: 8:15 PM to 9:05 PM.
MOTIVE: A six-inch telescope lens makes an incredible camera lens, if you don't care who you ruin.
templates.scene: The rooftop observatory on Fronczak Hall
templates.act: took the lens off the telescope
templates.motive: A portfolio deadline and a shot that needed glass nobody could afford.
templates.solvePath: Everyone signed out of the observatory at 8:05 PM. The culprit's camera case, returned at 9:40 PM, has foam cut for the lens and grease on it. The innocent's work order is for teaching lens T-14, which is still on the shelf.
templates.accessDescription: Media Cage equipment return, 9:40 PM, under {name}. A hard camera case. The foam inside has a fresh six-inch circle cut out of it, and there is telescope grease on the foam. The serial scratched into the grease reads L-88. The missing lens is L-88.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} took lens L-88 off the telescope, carried it out in their camera case, and returned the case without wiping it down.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Fronczak observatory visitor sheet IN at 7:30 PM and OUT at 8:05 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the physics department's list of students with permission to photograph on the quad that night.
templates.alibiDescription: Observatory visitor sheet. {name} signed out at 8:05 PM. The roof door does not lock from the outside and nobody was at the desk after 8:00 PM.
templates.redHerringDescription: A physics department work order at 3:00 PM. {name} signed out a telescope lens for cleaning.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} cleaned teaching lens T-14 and signed it back in at 3:40 PM. T-14 is on the shelf. The missing lens is L-88, the big one.
templates.statementTemplate: I signed out of the roof at 8:05 and went down to shoot the quad. The telescope was fine when I left.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Media Cage equipment return, 3:15 PM, under {name}. A soft camera bag. The foam is intact, and the slip says teaching lens T-14. T-14 was back on the shelf at 3:40 PM. The missing lens is L-88, returned in a hard case at 9:40 PM.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} returned a soft bag with teaching lens T-14 at 3:15 PM. The missing lens is L-88.

templates.title: Incubator left open
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody opened incubator B, silenced the alarm, and let a rival group's cultures die.
WHERE: The incubator room in Hochstetter Hall.
WHEN: 2:10 PM to 2:40 PM.
MOTIVE: Judging for the research showcase is tomorrow, and only one group gets the summer funding.
templates.scene: The incubator room in Hochstetter Hall
templates.act: opened incubator B and shut the alarm off
templates.motive: Summer funding goes to one group. With the rival cultures dead, there is only one group left.
templates.solvePath: The alarm was silenced with a lab PIN. Each PIN belongs to one person. The culprit's PIN silenced it at 2:23 PM. The prep kitchen badge at 2:51 PM is after the window. The innocent's cold packs are still in the teaching lab fridge.
templates.accessDescription: Incubator B alarm panel. Door opened at 2:22 PM. Alarm silenced at 2:23 PM with lab PIN 4471. PIN 4471 is assigned to {name}. Each lab PIN is assigned to exactly one person.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} opened incubator B at 2:22 PM and typed in their own PIN to silence the alarm a minute later.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed out of Hochstetter cleanup at 2:05 PM. Cleanup rotation covers the incubator room.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is in one of the two groups competing for the summer research funding.
templates.alibiDescription: Prep kitchen badge reader. {name}'s badge read at 2:51 PM. The prep kitchen is a two-minute walk from the incubator room.
templates.redHerringDescription: Cold-pack checkout slip, 9:00 AM. {name} signed out six cold packs. Cold packs are what you'd use to carry live cultures out of a building.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} restocked the teaching lab fridge with those cold packs at 9 AM. All six are still in that fridge, unopened.
templates.statementTemplate: I finished cleanup and went to the prep kitchen. Incubator B was humming when I walked past it.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Incubator A alarm panel. The door was opened at 9:12 AM and the alarm was silenced with lab PIN 2204, which belongs to {name}. Incubator A is the teaching unit. The dead cultures were in incubator B, and PIN 2204 was not used on B.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} silenced incubator A in the morning with PIN 2204. The dead cultures were in incubator B.

templates.title: Reserve book taken
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody walked off with the only reserve copy of Organic Chemistry II, third edition.
WHERE: The reserve desk in Silverman Library.
WHEN: 3:15 PM to 3:40 PM.
MOTIVE: The 5 PM midterm uses problems that only exist in that edition.
templates.scene: The reserve desk in Silverman Library
templates.act: took the reserve book off the desk
templates.motive: No book, no problem set, no way to study. Taking the book meant nobody else could either.
templates.solvePath: Everyone was on the wait list. The culprit tried to self-checkout the reserve copy at 3:27 PM, got refused, and the book was gone a minute later. The innocent bought their own copy of the right edition that morning.
templates.accessDescription: Silverman self-checkout kiosk, 3:27 PM. {name}'s card tried to check out the reserve copy of Organic Chemistry II. The kiosk refused it, since reserve items can't leave the building. The book was gone from the desk by 3:29 PM.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} tried to check the reserve copy out legally, got refused, and walked out with it anyway.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Organic II reserve wait list at 2:50 PM. Their name was third in line.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the 5:00 PM Organic Chemistry II midterm list.
templates.alibiDescription: Silverman study room 4 was booked under {name} from 3:45 PM to 5:00 PM. The booking was made at 3:41 PM.
templates.redHerringDescription: A bookstore receipt, 9:15 AM. {name} bought a copy of Organic Chemistry II.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} bought the third edition. It's in their backpack with the receipt in it. Someone who owns the book has no reason to steal it.
templates.statementTemplate: I waited for the book, gave up, and booked a study room. I never went behind the desk.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Silverman self-checkout kiosk, 11:02 AM. {name}'s card checked out a circulating copy of Organic Chemistry I. The kiosk accepted it, and the book was returned at 2:00 PM. It is not the reserve copy of Organic Chemistry II.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} checked out a regular copy of Organic Chemistry I in the morning and returned it. That is not the reserve copy of Organic Chemistry II.

templates.title: Broken window at Crosby
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody smashed the bench window in the greenhouse and took a flat of seedlings.
WHERE: Greenhouse bay 1 at Crosby Hall.
WHEN: 5:55 AM to 6:25 AM.
MOTIVE: The gardener said no to a plant request yesterday. Somebody didn't take no.
templates.act: put in the door code, broke the bench window, and took the seedlings
templates.motive: A project needed those seedlings today, and the gardener wouldn't release them.
templates.solvePath: The greenhouse keypad accepted a code at 6:04 AM. That code was issued to the culprit for watering duty and should have been revoked. The service road radio check is at 5:48 AM, before the window. The innocent's work order is for bay 2, scheduled tomorrow.
templates.accessDescription: Crosby greenhouse door keypad, 6:04 AM. Code 2208 accepted. Code 2208 was issued to {name} for a watering rotation last month and was never revoked. Nobody else was given that code.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} let themselves into the greenhouse with their old watering code at 6:04 AM, broke the bench window from inside, and left with the seedlings.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the early morning sheet at 5:40 AM for outside routes.
templates.rosterDescription: The gardener's log from yesterday. {name} asked for a flat of seedlings and was told no.
templates.alibiDescription: Service road radio log. {name} called in a check from the service road at 5:48 AM. The service road passes forty feet from the greenhouse.
templates.redHerringDescription: A facilities work order with {name}'s name on it for a cracked greenhouse window. Dated last week.
templates.redHerringExplanation: That work order is for a cracked pane in bay 2, and the repair is scheduled for tomorrow. This morning's break is the bench window in bay 1. Different glass, different room.
templates.statementTemplate: I was out on the service road at dawn. I haven't been inside that greenhouse since my watering rotation ended.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Crosby greenhouse door keypad, 4:30 PM yesterday. Code 1001 was accepted. Code 1001 is the daytime tour code posted on the board, and {name} was on the afternoon tour list. The morning break used code 2208, which is a different code.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} used the public tour code 1001 the afternoon before. The morning break used code 2208.

templates.title: House amp taken from Slee
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody wheeled the house amp out of a practice room.
WHERE: Practice room 3 in Slee Hall.
WHEN: 9:30 PM to 10:15 PM.
MOTIVE: There's a show tonight and somebody's own amp died at soundcheck.
templates.act: wheeled the house amp out the dock
templates.motive: The show starts at eleven. No amp, no set, no gig money.
templates.solvePath: Everyone dropped their key by 9:24 PM. The dock log shows the culprit signed out a hand truck at 9:50 PM, and the dock camera caught the amp on it at 10:05 PM. The innocent's 'borrowing the loud one' note is a permission slip for tomorrow morning.
templates.accessDescription: Slee Hall loading dock. A hand truck was signed out to {name} at 9:50 PM. The dock camera still from 10:05 PM shows that hand truck with a black amp strapped to it. The hand truck was never signed back in.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} came back into Slee after dropping their key, signed out a hand truck, and wheeled the house amp out the dock.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the Slee stage crew list for tonight. Crew call ended at 9:00 PM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} had practice room 3 reserved until 9:20 PM tonight.
templates.alibiDescription: Slee key-return box log. {name} dropped their room key at 9:24 PM. Dropping a key doesn't lock the dock.
templates.redHerringDescription: {name}'s room 3 reservation card for 8:00 AM tomorrow. In the notes: 'borrowing the loud one.'
templates.redHerringExplanation: 'The loud one' is the house amp, and the note is a request to use it at 8 AM tomorrow. The room manager approved and initialed it. Somebody with permission for tomorrow doesn't steal it tonight.
templates.statementTemplate: I dropped my key in the box before 9:30 and left. The amp was in the room when I closed the door.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Slee Hall loading dock. A hand truck was signed out to {name} at 2:00 PM and signed back in at 2:40 PM. The dock camera at 2:15 PM shows folding chairs on it. The amp left on a hand truck at 10:05 PM, and that truck was not signed back in.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} used a hand truck in the afternoon for folding chairs and signed it back in. The amp left at 10:05 PM on a truck that was not returned.

templates.title: Fire alarm at Baldy
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody pulled the fire alarm in the middle of a quiz. There was no fire.
WHERE: The third floor of Baldy Hall.
WHEN: 8:05 PM to 8:20 PM.
MOTIVE: Somebody wasn't ready for that quiz.
templates.scene: The third floor of Baldy Hall
templates.alibiPlace: in my seat in the quiz room
templates.motive: The quiz was unannounced. One more zero and the student loses their scholarship GPA.
templates.solvePath: Everyone was marked present at 8:00 PM. The pull station has a tamper dye pack. The culprit showed up at the health desk with blue dye on their hand. The innocent's 'pulling the alarm lol' message is a joke forty people saw.
templates.accessDescription: Baldy third-floor pull station is fitted with a tamper dye pack. Health desk log, 8:40 PM: {name} came in with blue dye on their right hand and asked how to get it off. They said it was from a pen.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} pulled the alarm, got the tamper dye on their hand, and went to the health desk to wash it off.
templates.signInDescription: Quiz attendance sheet. {name} was marked present at 8:00 PM. Nobody was marked after the alarm.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is on the roster for the third-floor section that was taking the quiz.
templates.alibiDescription: {name} was marked present at 8:00 PM. The pull station is in the hallway, eleven steps from the quiz room door. Students were allowed to use the bathroom during the quiz.
templates.redHerringDescription: A message from {name} in the class group chat at 7:52 PM. 'if this quiz is real I'm pulling the alarm lol.'
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} sent that joke to forty people and was in their seat when the alarm went off. Three classmates confirmed it. The person who actually did it didn't announce it.
templates.statementTemplate: I was in my seat when it went off. I filed out with everybody else.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: Health desk log, 4:10 PM. {name} came in for a paper cut on their left thumb. The note says no dye and no stain. The alarm dye is blue, and the 8:40 PM visit was a right hand.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} went to the health desk at 4:10 PM for a paper cut. There was no blue dye, and it was not 8:40 PM.

templates.title: Grade change at the registrar
templates.briefing:
WHAT: Somebody changed a failing grade to a B on a registrar computer that was left logged in.
WHERE: The registrar suite in O'Brian Hall.
WHEN: 12:20 AM to 12:55 AM.
MOTIVE: That grade was going to the dean's list committee in the morning.
templates.scene: The registrar suite in O'Brian Hall
templates.act: went back into the suite and changed the grade
templates.motive: A failing grade on a transcript headed to a scholarship committee at 9 AM.
templates.solvePath: All the student workers signed out at 12:10 AM. The staff side door is the only way into the suite after midnight, and it logged the culprit's card at 12:31 AM. The innocent on the night class list was marked present in the lecture hall at 12:30 AM.
templates.accessDescription: O'Brian Hall staff side door. {name}'s card entered at 12:31 AM. After midnight the staff side door is the only route into the registrar suite. The grade change was saved at 12:41 AM.
templates.contradictionExplanation: {name} signed out at 12:10, walked around to the staff side door, came back in at 12:31 AM, and saved the grade change ten minutes later.
templates.signInDescription: {name} signed the student worker close-out sheet at 11:50 PM and signed out of the building at 12:10 AM.
templates.rosterDescription: {name} is one of four student workers on the registrar evening desk sheet. The computer was left logged in at 11:40 PM.
templates.alibiDescription: O'Brian Hall sign-out sheet. {name} signed out at 12:10 AM. The sign-out sheet is at the front desk. The staff side door has its own card reader.
templates.redHerringDescription: {name} is on the O'Brian night class list. The grade that was changed is in a course {name} is currently failing.
templates.redHerringExplanation: {name} is failing that course, but they were marked present in the lecture hall at 12:30 AM, and their student card doesn't open the staff side door.
templates.statementTemplate: I signed the close-out sheet, signed out at 12:10, and went home. I didn't go back into the suite.
templates.decoyAccessDescription: O'Brian Hall front door. {name}'s card entered at 11:02 PM and left at 11:18 PM. The front door does not open the registrar suite after the desk closes. The grade change used the staff side door at 12:31 AM.
templates.decoyAccessExplanation: {name} used the front door at 11:02 PM and left at 11:18 PM. The grade change used the staff side door at 12:31 AM.
